solutionsPage.lede: From water to soil, from the plant to the value of the land: each family of solutions fixes one specific problem — and they reinforce one another.

evergreen.name: EVERGREEN® & ECOSORB®
evergreen.tagline: Water stays where the roots are.
evergreen.lede: 100% biodegradable, potassium-based super-absorbent polymers — free of sodium and acrylamide. Mixed into the substrate at planting, they capture rain or irrigation water, store it as a gel and release it as the plant needs it.

hero.label: its weight in water, stored as a gel in the root zone
hero.alt: Beaker demonstration: water-retainer granules swell into gel on contact with water

problem.title: The problem: water drains away — and fertiliser with it.
problem.text: Irrigation water evaporates or percolates out of reach of the roots, and most fertiliser is leached away before the plant can use it. The result: stressed crops, compacting soils, and rising water and input bills.
problem.valueLabel: of conventional fertiliser can be leached away before it acts

how.title: How it works
how.alt: Young plant with roots anchored in water-retainer gel, shown in a soil cross-section
how.caption: Roots intertwine with the gel grains and draw water from them as needed.

steps.title: The dry grain absorbs
steps.text: On contact with rain or irrigation water, each gram of water retainer captures up to 300 ml of water.

steps.title: The gel stores
steps.text: Water is stored as a gel in the root zone, safe from evaporation and leaching.

steps.title: The plant draws
steps.text: Irrigate normally for the first three weeks: the roots intertwine with the saturated grains and then draw on them as needed.

steps.title: The grain degrades cleanly
steps.text: Within 2 to 3 years (EVERGREEN®) or 1 to 2 years (ECOSORB®), the polymer breaks down into C, H₂O, O₂ and K — used as nutrients. Nothing else remains in the soil.

items.title: Fertiliser stays in the field
items.text: Dissolved nutrients are captured by the gel and remain available to the crop instead of polluting groundwater and rivers.

items.title: Looser, living soil

items.q: Do I need to change equipment or practices?
items.a: No. The product is mixed into the substrate at planting, by hand or by machine, depending on the farm’s equipment. A simple protocol and precise dosages per crop are provided.

items.q: Is it compatible with organic farming?
items.a: Yes. The potassium- and maize-starch-based formulations are natural elements, safe for plants, the soil and its microbial life — they even ease the transition from conventional to certified organic.

items.q: What happens to the product in the soil?
items.a: It biodegrades into C, H₂O, O₂ and K at a rate of 20 to 25% per year, under the action of microfauna, microflora and fungi. Its molecules are too large to be absorbed by plants: no component ends up in plant tissue.

items.q: EVERGREEN® or ECOSORB®: which one should I choose?
items.a: EVERGREEN® (potassium-based) works for 2 to 3 years, ECOSORB® (potassium + maize starch) for 1 to 2 years. The choice — and the grain size — depend on your soil, crop and cycle length; we determine them with you.

items.q: Do I need to keep irrigating?
items.a: Yes, normally for the first three weeks, while the grains saturate and the roots anchor into them. After that, irrigation frequency drops by 50 to 80%.

items.q: In which soils does it work?
items.a: In all soil types, including sand, where water waste is greatest. The grains capture, store and release water repeatedly throughout the cycle.

paulownia.synergy: By incorporating 50 g of EVERGREEN® per plant at planting, irrigation consumption is halved and the tree has a permanent water reserve: the effects of water stress are erased. A complete solution for reforestation and against desertification.

items.q: In which climates can it be planted?
items.a: It tolerates −25°C to +45°C and adapts to a wide variety of soils — this is the hybrid we selected precisely for hot, dry regions.

items.q: How much water does it really use?
items.a: 5 litres per day on annual average (5 to 7 L in extreme heatwaves), versus at least 25 litres for other varieties. With the EVERGREEN® water retainer incorporated at planting, irrigation drops by half again.

items.q: What maintenance does the plantation need?
items.a: Drip irrigation, protection from wildlife, pruning early in the cycle. No staking, and no obligatory clearing of fallen branches: the leaves break down quickly and do not build up flammable matter.

items.q: When do you harvest?
items.a: First harvest possible from the end of year 3, or at 6 and 8 years depending on the market. At 6-8 years, the tree reaches 13 to 15 metres.

items.q: What scientific validation is there?
items.a: CPVO EU 39980 variety certification, CNPF-IDF studies from July 2025, a Frontiers in Environmental Science publication (2024) on CO₂ mitigation, and a 22-hectare trial centre in Toledo (Spain) with an EC-approved agronomy laboratory.

items.q: Is it risky near homes or forests?
items.a: Quite the opposite: igniting only at 426°C, it serves as a fire barrier. In Tarascon in 2022, after the fire, only our paulownias were left standing.

companyPage.h1: From Le Pradet, for fields the world over.

vision.title: What we believe
vision.lead: Farming can be intensive and regenerative at the same time — provided you treat the whole system: water, soil, plant.
vision.text: Green Solutions develops and markets disruptive agricultural technologies that answer the four challenges of modern farming: water stress, soil exhaustion, profitability, food security. From the family farm to national reforestation programmes, the same standard applies: measurable results.
